- [FACT] User is interested in whiskey blending.
- [PREFERENCE] User is seeking a whiskey blend that closely resembles Nikka Yoichi Peaty & Salty.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Creating a whiskey blend that closely resembles Nikka Yoichi Peaty & Salty at home can be challenging.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nikka Yoichi Peaty & Salty is a product of the Yoichi Distillery in Hokkaido, Japan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The specific combination of ingredients, aging process, and craftsmanship of Nikka Yoichi Peaty & Salty are unique to the distillery.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested approach for blending includes starting with a base of Japanese whiskey.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended base Japanese whiskeys include:
  * Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt (less peaty)
  * Suntory Hakushu 12 Years Old (more peaty)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested adding a Scotch whisky with a peaty profile to enhance peatiness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended peaty Scotch whiskies include:
  * Ardbeg 10 Years Old
  * Laphroaig 10 Years Old
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested adding a Scotch whisky with a coastal/salty profile to introduce maritime saltiness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended coastal/salty Scotch whiskies include:
  * Old Pulteney 12 Years Old
  * Talisker 10 Years Old
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should experiment with proportions to find the right balance of flavors.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should start with the base Japanese whiskey and gradually add the peaty and salty Scotch whiskies, tasting along the way.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should keep notes of the proportions used for future recreation or adjustments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Blending whiskeys is a matter of personal taste, encouraging exploration of different combinations.
